entry.title: A place at the meal
entry.summary: The authors offer a low table once the baby sits steadily with feet reaching the floor, and also welcome a tray-less high chair at the family table. The choice serves the family’s meals.
entry.cue: You are considering how your baby takes part in mealtimes.
detail: A low table and chair may be used for snacks, some meals or more often if that fits. The authors connect its fit with stability and participation.

They also value eating together at the family table, where the baby can be part of the conversation. The book’s earlier general preference against high chairs is qualified by this family-table alternative.
